page.layout: One text column with running head at top; page number top right; a horizontal rule separates the running text from the new chapter, which begins below it with a centred heading and a drop-cap paragraph. No marginal notes. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: manam, in causâ[?], in quâ si ipse

page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment ("ventu") and is kept as printed. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed. "causâ" and its accent are uncertain and marked [?]. The catchword "in-" is at the foot right and is kept out of the text. The drop cap "E" is joined to "Tiamsi" as "ETiamsi". The long s is written as plain s throughout. The faint watermark at the lower right is the digitiser's mark and is not transcribed.
